A DATE WITH CURIOSITY

Two people.
One rabbit hole.

  1. Pick a subject or let chance decide.
  2. Read the topic together. There are no right answers.
  3. Person 1 talks for a minute while Person 2 listens.
  4. Pass the turn. Person 2 gets their minute.
  5. Keep talking or find another rabbit hole.

Put the screen between you. Let the conversation do the rest.
